mapper.select: select *,count(cp.uid) as participantCount from fitian.Class c left join fitian.Class_participant cp on c.classNo = cp.classNo where boxCode = #{boxCode} and classDate between #{startDate} and #{endDate} group by c.classNo order by classDate, startTime
select cp.uid, m.name from fitian.Class_participant cp inner join fitian.Member m on cp.uid = m.uid where classNo = #{classNo}
mapper.insert: insert into fitian.Class (boxCode, classDate, startTime, endTime, classMemberCapacity, classTitle, classMemo) value (#{boxCode},#{classDate},#{startTime},#{endTime},#{classMemberCapacity},#{classTitle},#{classMemo})
mapper.update:
update fitian.Class SET
classDate=#{classDate},
startTime=#{startTime},
endTime=#{endTime},
classMemberCapacity=#{classMemberCapacity},
classTitle=#{classTitle},
classMemo=#{classMemo},
boxCode=#{boxCode} where classNo = #{classNo}
mapper.delete: delete from fitian.Class_participant where classNo = #{classNo} and uid = #{uid}
